name: gradle
versions: Gradle 7–9 with the project's existing JDK

allocations.name: gradle
allocations.purpose: Gradle dependencies, wrapper distributions and caches

allocations.name: gradle
allocations.purpose: Non-secret Gradle properties and init scripts

notes: Create an empty generated gradle.properties only when missing. Prefer the project's wrapper; its pinned distribution can populate isolated state. Inspect Gradle/JDK compatibility before execution. Disable automatic JDK downloads; missing JDKs are explicit prerequisites. Avoid a persistent daemon so cleanup cannot race detached workers. Preserve project properties, caches and outputs. Never copy credential properties from the host.
